quote: Amended § 11.2 (Amendment No. 1 § 2.1) excludes only: (a) Supplier's indemnity under § 9.1, "which are excluded solely to third-party intellectual property claims under Section 9.1(c)" ... | Product defect / personal injury indemnity (§ 9.1(a)–(b), (d)) | Uncapped | Capped at 6 months of fees | | Recall costs (§ 10) | Uncapped | Capped at 6 months of fees |
reason: The memo says the amendment replaces Supply Agreement § 11.2, which is the substance of the criterion. It says recall costs were removed from the carve-outs and the indemnity carve-out now covers only third-party IP claims. It also explains that recall and product-liability exposure is now capped at six months of fees. It cites the amendment as § 2.1, a subsection of Section 2, so that is consistent with the criterion. It does not mention the Section 15.2 precedence clause, but the criterion does not require it.
